reviews.title: Barely usable
reviews.text:
I used to pay VIP, but it got a bit expensive for me. Don't bother to download if you cant pay, because there's ads every time you start a song, which I'm fine with. The thing is, the ad doesnt let you close it after it's done. The "x" does not work! It just keeps sending you to the app store. Some ads dont even have an "x" to close them, so then I have to restart the app, and guess what? I have to watch a whole other ad when trying to start a new song. 

The only reason I havent delete it yet is because of all my previous recordings. 🫠
